userQuestion: https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio 해당 리포지토리를 활용하여 카툰 릴스에 보이스 더빙도 가능할까?
conclusion: Technically feasible using Korean per-line TTS and external Reel timeline mixing. Supertonic-3 presets are a practical audition candidate; do not use the default OmniVoice pretrained weights for this commercial promotion.
evidenceLevel: Official repository documentation, upstream model cards and exact model-license text reviewed. No local installation, model download or real Korean speech test performed.

environment.memory: Not measured; sandbox denies sysctl. No memory/performance guarantee.

application.assessment: Official notice explicitly includes commercial/internal use of the application under its terms. It does not grant rights for models, voices or output.

defaultOmniVoice.decision: Excluded from app-promotion dubbing unless separate commercial rights are obtained.

limitations: VoiceStudio adapter exposes preset voices, not voice design or cloning.
Natural Korean comic delivery and matching the chosen characters are not proven until listening.

Audition 장고가 이렇게 빨랐어? and 오픈런도 런이잖아. before selecting recurring character voices.
Export separate WAV takes and align with the five scenes; adjust shot duration if needed rather than forcing rushed speech.
